thread:
anya: Short meeting notes from today's quick sync — we need a single, opinionated v1 for Dedicated fallback ordering and autoscale defaults so sales and SREs can promise behavior.

mike: Agreed. We keep the implementation surface small: do per-tenant ordering, no cross-region moves for v1.

anya: Proposed default ordering (v1): 1) tenant warm-pool (if purchased) -> 2) regional overflow pool (soft-shared buffer) -> 3) model-size-downscale (smaller/quant variant) -> 4) best-effort spot/cheaper instance (only as last resort). Make it tenant-configurable.

greta: Product note: top tier customers want warm-pool first always. Default should respect paid prewarm before anything else. Good to expose ordering toggles in Console.

sunil: Ops note: regional overflow needs per-tenant soft quotas and a fast-cut toggle. Also need clear metrics for when overflow is hit.

emily: Billing asks: emit a label per request: `fallback_path:warm|overflow|downscale|spot` and a `fallback_flag=true` so invoicing can attribute. Also want a preview export for pilots.

mike: Runtime work: mapping table from model -> compatible downscale variants + runtime switch to prefer warm/overflow first. Overflow admission control + token accounting required. Canary flag required.

ops-bot: DEPLOY NOTE: created feature flag: feature.dedicated.fallback_v1. Use to scope canary tenants.

anya: Telemetry we must collect on fallback events: tenant_id, request_id, original_model, fallback_path, added_latency_ms, tokens, was_prewarm. Alerts: for SLA customers alert if fallback rate > 0.2% over 5m and added_latency_avg > 50ms.

sunil: Also add an ops dashboard: top tenants by fallback_rate, fallback_path distribution, and median latency delta per path. Runbook must include how to disable fallback per tenant and how to rollback ordering.

greta: Acceptance criteria (product/UX):
- Console: per-tenant ordering editor + one-click override + visible audit trail for changes.
- Default ordering applied account-wide for v1 unless tenant overrides.
- Dashboard tiles for fallback counts, % of requests, and avg latency penalty.
- Customer-facing FAQ blurb and email template for pilot customers.

emily: Billing acceptance: hourly aggregator writes `fallback_ledger:{tenant}:{hour}` with counts by path and projected burst tokens. Dry-run export CSV available to pilots.

mike: Dev acceptance: mapping table config example (WIP):
```
model: redwood-1x
fallback_variants:
  - redwood-1x-int8
  - redwood-1-small
max_latency_penalty_ms: 120
```
Include per-tenant policy override in tenant config store.

anya: Launch gates:
- Spec + UX signoff (this thread)
- Mapping table + unit + integration tests
- Overflow admission control + per-tenant caps implemented
- Telemetry + dashboard tiles active
- Billing ledger + dry-run export ready
- Canary to 4 pilot tenants for 72h with alerts enabled
- Rollback toggle available in Console and via admin API

sunil: Ops gating: alerts live and oncall runbook updated before any canary. Add diagnostic CLI to list active fallbacks and toggle per tenant.

greta: Risk register quick:
- Quality regression risk when using downscale models. Mitigation: require model-owner opt-in for automatic downscale for GA customers; for pilots allow opt-in per tenant.
- Confusion/rage from unexpected routing. Mitigation: explicit response header/display `x-redwood-fallback: overflow` and a short explanation in response when fallback was used.
- Billing surprises. Mitigation: dry-run export + preview during pilot + clear invoice lines.

emily: Also require audit logs for each fallback event (immutable) for disputes.

mike: Timeline: engineering estimates 2 sprints for mapping + telemetry + flags. Overflow admission + per-tenant caps another sprint. Console UX 1 sprint parallel. Billing dry-run exporter 1 sprint. Canary 1 week with pilot tenants.

anya: Action items:
- mike: runtime spec for mapping + sample tenant override config (due Fri)
- sunil: alert definitions + runbook steps + ops dashboard mock (due Tue)
- greta: Console ordering UX mock + FAQ email copy (due Tue)
- emily: billing ledger schema + dry-run export plan (due Wed)
- anya: recruit 4 pilot tenants and prepare pilot consent (due Mon)

ops-bot: REMINDER: add canary flag to tenant onboarding flow for pilot tenants.

anya: If no objections, I'll lock v1 scope and file tickets. Any last flags?

mike: No objections. Keep cross-region routing for v2.

greta: No objections. Ensure wording on Console differentiates "projected" vs "billed".

emily: Billing OK with dry-run requirement enforced.

sunil: Ops OK, blocking canary until alerts are in place.

anya: Locking scope. Will follow up with PRs and ticket links in #eng-runtime and #console. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
